newsitem.title: USA: ECI Telecom wins $17.5 mln in orders.
newsitem.headline: ECI Telecom wins $17.5 mln in orders.

text.p: ECI Telecom Ltd said on Monday it received orders worth $17.5 million from two major carriers for its DTX-240 and DTX-360 digital circuit multiplication equipment, or DCME.
Sprint Corp ordered $10.1 million worth of DTX-360 equipment for deployment in its global networks in early 1997.
Another unidentified global carrier ordered $7.4 million worth of DTX-240 for delivery in the fourth quarter of 1996 and the first quarter of 1997, the company said.
ECI is based in Petah Tikva, Israel.
